item.title: We graded 13,216 American cities with FBI data. Here's what we found.
item.description: 57% of American cities get an A. That isn't grade inflation — it's what happens when you measure mostly-small municipalities against a national average. A look at the distribution, the 15x gap between the top and bottom bands, and the places where a letter grade means almost nothing.
